definition: Individuals who have used the Internet from any location in the last three months as a share of population
known_confounders: age structure income education infrastructure measurement method
notes: Do not treat Internet access as equivalent to quality affordability or intensity of use

variable_name: Share of electricity generation from renewables
definition: Electricity generated from renewable sources as a share of total electricity generation
known_confounders: hydrology resource availability grid structure energy policy generation mix
notes: Renewables include solar wind hydropower bioenergy geothermal wave and tidal; generation share is not installed capacity share
